text:
eve: Heads-up: onboarding sample shows duplicate webhook jobs after users tap "replay" repeatedly. Backend logs spike 429s then clients flood retry. Anyone seen this pattern elsewhere?

samir: Which SDK/version and call shape? streaming vs sync?

eve: Node sampleapp v1.5.3, sync generate only. Happens when users click replay while prior request pending.

toni: Classic problem: missing client-side debounce + no idempotency header. Node SDK still hasn't landed the parity helper we added in python. Current node retries are linear-ish and no jitter.

samir: Two angles: UX (debounce + session fingerprint store) and SDK (exp-backoff + jitter + idempotency helper). Also server-side dedupe TTL for webhook receivers.

eve: Also noticed some 429s without Retry-After header. Snippet: 
```
[2026-03-22T09:12:11Z] POST /v1/generate 429 - x-req: r_f9 - body: {"error":"rate_limited"}
```
No Retry-After. That causes clients to fall back to aggressive retries.

toni: That might be from smart-routing fast-fail. Infra should audit.

samir: SDK proposal: default retry -> exponential backoff with full jitter; add client.withIdempotency(key) helper that sets X-Redwood-Idempotency for non-streaming calls only. Example defaults: maxRetries=4, baseMs=150, maxMs=2400, jitter=full.

eve: UX quick fixes: add 400ms debounce on replay button, store lastRequestFingerprint in sessionStorage and suppress identical resubmits for 3 minutes. Also surface a small toast if a duplicate is detected.

toni: I'll take the node SDK PR. Will add unit tests ensuring header present for sync and absent for streaming. Also add an integration that simulates 50 concurrent identical requests and asserts one webhook delivery.

samir: I'll update the sampleapp and onboarding docs to show how to compute a short fingerprint: 
```
const fp = sha256(userId + '|' + prompt).slice(0,16)
X-Redwood-Idempotency: fp
```
Server keep TTL=5min.

eve: Infra: please check fast-fail path for missing Retry-After. That audit ticket would be helpful.

infra-bot: Created INF-821: audit smart-routing fast-fail for missing Retry-After header.

toni: Timeline? Would like node PR + sampleapp change in staging by mid-week so docs can ship before next onboarding run.

eve: Great — ping here if blocked. Small changes should cut duplicate deliveries a lot. :raised_hands:
